items.title: Assessing irrigation-driven carbon emissions across the Murray–Darling Basin: first insight from publicly available datasets
items.title_en: Assessing irrigation-driven carbon emissions across the Murray–Darling Basin: first insight from publicly available datasets
items.title_zh: 评估默里-达令盆地因灌溉导致的碳排放：基于公开数据集的初步见解
items.summary_en: Agricultural irrigation is the largest consumptive use of water in Australia. It heavily relies on energy-intensive pumping systems, linking water use to greenhouse gas emissions within the energy-water-food nexus. This study provides the first basin-scale estimate of irrigation energy use and associated emissions across the Murray–Darling Basin. It integrates publicly accessible datasets on agricultural energy, water use, and irrigation activity within a transparent and replicable top-down framework. Three scenarios were developed to estimate irrigation energy demand and associated emissions while reflecting uncertainty in irrigation’s share of agricultural energy use. Results indicate that irrigation-related emissions range from 4.5 to 9.01 Mt CO2-e annually, corresponding to 0.53–1.06 t CO2-e per ml of water applied. Emissions are dominated by grid electricity, although diesel use remains important in regions with limited grid access. Spatial analysis of proximity to electricity infrastructure enables a more refined allocation of energy sources. The results highlight spatial disparities in decarbonisation potential across the Basin. The findings demonstrate that electricity decarbonisation offers the greatest mitigation opportunity, complemented by electrification and decentralised renewable energy systems in off-grid areas. The framework provides the first transparent and transferable basin-scale benchmark for irrigation-related emissions. It establishes a foundation for targeted decarbonisation planning and future refinement as higher-resolution datasets become available.
items.summary_zh: 农业灌溉是澳大利亚最大的耗水用途。它高度依赖高能耗的抽水系统，从而在“能源-水-粮食”关联框架内将用水与温室气体排放联系起来。 本研究首次对默里-达令河流域的灌溉能耗及相关排放量进行了流域尺度的估算。研究在透明且可复现的自上而下框架内，整合了农业能源、用水量及灌溉活动方面的公开数据集。研究构建了三种情景，以估算灌溉能源需求及相关排放量，同时反映了灌溉在农业能源消耗中所占比例的不确定性。 结果表明，与灌溉相关的年排放量在4.5至9.01 Mt CO2-e之间，相当于每毫升灌溉用水排放0.53–1.06 t CO2-e。电网电力是排放的主要来源，但在电网覆盖有限的地区，柴油的使用仍占据重要地位。 基于电力基础设施邻近性的空间分析，有助于更精细地分配能源来源。结果凸显了该流域内各区域在脱碳潜力方面的空间差异。 研究结果表明，电力脱碳提供了最大的减排机遇，并在离网地区辅以电气化和分散式可再生能源系统。该框架为灌溉相关排放提供了首个透明且可推广的流域级基准，为有针对性的脱碳规划奠定了基础，并为未来随着更高分辨率数据集的可用而进行的优化提供了基础。

items.summary_en: To meet the Kunming–Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework, spatial planning must upscale area-based conservation, while ensuring equitable governance and local community integration. Historically, a deep divide has persisted between data-driven, top-down systematic conservation planning, often performed at large spatial scales, and participatory, bottom-up local initiatives. Here, we propose a novel framework that bridges this gap by harnessing the power of human and artificial intelligence. By deploying a technique called Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback in our software CAPTAIN (conservation area prioritization through artificial intelligence), our approach can process vast biophysical and socioeconomic data to create fine-tuned conservation strategies that are both data-driven and sensitive to local realities. The methodology outlined here provides a promising avenue for scalable, effective, and equitable biodiversity conservation.
items.summary_zh: 为落实《昆明-蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》，空间规划必须在扩大区域性保护规模的同时，确保治理的公平性以及与当地社区的融合。 从历史上看，以数据为驱动、自上而下的系统性保护规划（通常在大空间尺度上实施）与参与式、自下而上的地方倡议之间一直存在着深刻的鸿沟。在此，我们提出了一个利用人类智能与人工智能相结合的创新框架，以弥合这一差距。 通过在我们的软件 CAPTAIN（基于人工智能的保护区优先排序）中部署一种名为“带人类反馈的强化学习”的技术，我们的方法能够处理海量的生物物理和社会经济数据，从而制定出既以数据为驱动又兼顾当地实际情况的精细化保护策略。 本文概述的方法为可扩展、有效且公平的生物多样性保护开辟了一条充满希望的道路。

items.title: Comment on ‘global human population has surpassed Earth’s sustainable carrying capacity’
items.title_en: Comment on ‘global human population has surpassed Earth’s sustainable carrying capacity’
items.title_zh: 关于“全球人口已超过地球的可持续承载力”的评论
items.summary_en: Bradshaw et al (2026 Environ. Res. Lett.21 064023) argue that the global human population has now surpassed its sustainable carrying capacity, and that, since the 1960s, population growth better explains changes in indicators of global ecological change than increases in per-capita consumption. We argue that the methods they use are flawed both in their design and application. Inequality is the core issue. At its worst, Bradshaw et al’s method would interpret increases in mortality arising from ecological damages in poor and vulnerable regions of the world as an overpopulation problem, even when these damages are driven by affluent populations living elsewhere. But the problems with their proposed carrying capacity estimates go deeper, as the deceleration in global population growth that they interpret as evidence of overpopulation has many better explanations. In the presence of the vast inequalities that characterise the modern world, we argue that the only way to estimate carrying capacity and its contextual dependencies is to think about what people need and how these needs are met through provisioning systems and technologies.
items.summary_zh: 布拉德肖等人（2026年《环境研究快报》第21卷 064023）认为，全球人口现已超过其可持续承载力，且自20世纪60年代以来，人口增长比人均消费的增长更能解释全球生态变化指标的变化。 我们认为，他们所采用的方法无论在设计还是应用上都存在缺陷。不平等才是核心问题。最糟糕的情况下，布拉德肖等人所采用的方法甚至会将世界贫困和脆弱地区因生态破坏导致的死亡率上升解读为人口过剩问题，即使这些破坏实际上是由其他地方的富裕人口造成的。 但他们提出的承载力估算存在更深层次的问题，因为他们将全球人口增长放缓解释为人口过剩的证据，而这一现象其实有许多更合理的解释。 鉴于现代世界普遍存在的巨大不平等现象，我们认为，估算承载力及其情境依赖性的唯一途径，是思考人们的需求以及这些需求如何通过供给系统和技术得到满足。

items.title: Regional El Niño patterns shape wheat-flour price responses to climate disasters
items.title_en: Regional El Niño patterns shape wheat-flour price responses to climate disasters
items.title_zh: 区域性厄尔尼诺现象模式影响了小麦粉价格对气候灾害的反应
items.summary_en: Climate adaptation policy assumes that identical disasters create similar food security impacts regardless of location. Using monthly wheat-flour price data across 129 regions in 19 food-insecure countries (2000–2021), I show that the price impact of a disaster depends on the prevailing regional El Niño–Southern Oscillation (ENSO) phase, most clearly for floods. Floods produce opposite-signed responses across pressure states, with wheat-flour prices rising in drier (high-pressure) region-months and falling in wetter (low-pressure) ones, a contrast that emerges over the months after the event. Droughts raise prices in wetter (low-pressure) region-months. Storms show a similar but spike-driven increase in wetter region-months and act mainly through wind and damage rather than the water balance, and extreme temperatures show no robust effect. Because almost all sampled regions share the same correlation sign, the pressure contrast largely tracks the ENSO phase itself. The analysis exploits regional ENSO correlation interacting with the prevailing ENSO phase as quasi-experimental variation, using staggered difference-in-differences with disaster timing providing conditionally exogenous treatment assignment within regional climate states. The mechanisms behind the price changes are not fully resolved, and a price decline is not necessarily a welfare gain if it reflects demand disruption. The contribution is to show, in subnational price data from food-insecure importer markets, that a disaster’s price impact is contingent on the prevailing ENSO phase. This challenges the uniform vulnerability assumptions behind current adaptation frameworks and, because ENSO is forecastable months ahead, points toward phase-aware rather than uniform preparedness.

items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.29793v1 An: new Abstract: State crash databases differ in structure, coding, and injury-severity distributions, limiting direct reuse of predictive workflows across jurisdictions. This study adapts the SafeTraffic Copilot large language model (LLM) crash-severity workflow to a three-year Tennessee inventory of 624,392 crashes. Tennessee crash, roadway, vehicle, and person attributes were harmonized and converted into textual prompts while unavailable values were preserved rather than inferred. Llama 3.1 8B was fine-tuned using low-rank adaptation to classify five injury-severity categories. Random, county-based, and severity-balanced sampling strategies were evaluated using separate in-sample and unseen-test experiments; unseen-test experiments used 70/15/15 training, validation, and test splits. On their respective unseen test sets, random and county-based models achieved weighted F1-scores near 80%, but macro F1 remained below 47% and fatal-crash F1 below 27%, showing that strong aggregate performance can mask weak recognition of rare outcomes. Within its balanced evaluation population, the severity-balanced model achieved weighted and macro F1-scores of 57.7% and a fatalcrash F1-score of 65.9%, yielding more even class-level performance. Because each sampling strategy used a different test subset, crossstrategy differences are descriptive rather than controlled rankings. The results highlight the importance of interpreting LLM crashseverity performance together with sampling design, class balance, class-level metrics, and evaluation-population composition.
